 Television DC Correspondent 23 Oct 2026 12:06 PM IST 23 Oct 2026 12:06 PM IST Director Rohit Shetty will be hosting the Bigg Boss 20 weekend episode instead of Salman Khan.
 x Salman Khan. As Preferred
Source With each passing day, Bigg Boss 20 is getting intense among the viewers. In a recent episode, the contestants Uditi Singh and Arishfa Khan were seen discussing and guessing the top five finalists of Bigg Boss 20.
 During a live stream of Bigg Boss 20, contestants Uditi Singh and Arishfa Khan discussed who they believe could make it to the top five. Uditi shared her predictions, naming Gullu, Qazi Touqeer, Scout, Arishfa Khan and Mahhi Vij as her potential finalists.
 It is hard to decide who would make it to the top five finalists, as the show dynamics could change at any time.
 Do you agree with Uditi Singh's top five predictions? Let us know in the comments section below. We would love to hear from you.
 Director Rohit Shetty will be hosting the Bigg Boss 20 weekend episode instead of Salman Khan.
